title: Group-chat history can expose a secret even when lorebook entries are filtered
symptom: A community member describes characters using secrets from scenes they did not attend. Official SillyTavern docs say standard group chat history is shared between members.
user_impact: Fictional relationships lose coherence when information intended for one character leaks to another.

steps: For lorebook entries, use SillyTavern World Info Character Filter.
For group history, evaluate Presence extension to hide unwitnessed messages, and optionally Dragon Memories Manager to summarize witnessed events per character.
Treat Molfar Vertep's claimed code-enforced 'who knows what' approach as an experimental candidate, not proven superior.

remaining_question: Across different context injection paths, do Presence, DMM or Molfar consistently stop secret leakage without breaking other roleplay quality?
verification_plan: Construct a synthetic four-character 16-scene script with secrets; vary history, lorebook and narrator roles; count leaks by model and extension combination.
